content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 21 is structurally sound — the cap is expressly mutual, the indirect/consequential exclusion is mutual, and the "Excluded Claims" definition already carves out confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and the other party's IP, with Customer's payment obligations excluded from "damages". The single material failure is the cap basis: "Fees" is defined as the Implementation Fee (a one-time USD 12,000 charge in the first Order Form), so the cap is illusory and below the walk-away line. One surgical replace in § 21.1 sets the cap at the greater of fees paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, preserving all other wording verbatim.
